messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: streaming-queue-pressure (us-west-2). Severity: P2. Incident ID INC-20260317-72. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-20260317-72

emily: I'm oncall. Seeing 99th latency jump and a 5xx uptick on streaming routes. Investigating root cause now.

raj: Confirmed high mux backpressure. streaming-workers CPU ~95%, connection counts spiking from a few tenants.

kyle: Repro locally with long-lived chat sessions at sustained rps. KV cache miss rate up ~3x which is amplifying token cost.

emily: Proposal: temporarily disable SSE/streaming responses in us-west-2 for "standard" plans and let clients fall back to polling/chunked responses. Should reduce multiplex overhead and CPU.

maria: If we flip, need graceful degradation for SDKs and a status page update. Also watch client reconnect storms.

kyle: Runbook command (control plane flag) to canary the change for 5% of traffic: 

```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/flags \
  -d '{"flag":"streaming.enable_usw2","value":false,"target":"cohort:standard","rollout":5}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY"
```

emily: Starting canary at 5% now. Will monitor 2m windows for 5xx and token throughput.

ops-bot: Rollout job queued: rollout_id=rl-20260317-001, target=cohort:standard, region=us-west-2, canary=5%.

raj: After canary (2m): 99th latency down ~18%, CPU on streaming workers dropped to ~70%. No client error spike observed.

emily: Good. Moving to 30% then 100% if metrics hold. Tagging @sre_lead for handoff when we hit >30%.

sre_lead: Acknowledged. I'll take over the watch after the full toggle. Support: draft comms for impacted customers.

support_pager: Drafting status message: "We're temporarily pausing streaming responses in us-west-2 for Standard plans to stabilize latency. Polling/fetching endpoints remain available. Estimated mitigation window: ~60 min. We'll post updates." Will post once Emily confirms full rollout.

maria: Adding short-term per-tenant streaming rps caps for aggressive connections to reduce risk of reconnect storms:

```
redis-cli -h feature-store HSET quotas:stream:rps tenant:heavy_a 5
redis-cli -h feature-store HSET quotas:stream:rps tenant:heavy_b 8
```

kyle: Also enabling service-level rate shaping on mux layer for new connections: 10 conn/s global throttle.

emily: Progress: 5% -> 30% -> 100% completed over ~12 minutes. Metrics after full toggle: 99th latency improved ~500ms, streaming worker CPU steady ~60%, overall token throughput stable. Mitigation active.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation_active. Assigned to sre_lead for watch. Next automated update in 30m.

support_pager: Status page updated and email sent to top 50 customers. SDK note added: "If streaming is not available, SDK will fallback to poll mode (see docs)."

raj: Leaving action items for postmortem: improve streaming backpressure headroom, add automatic autoshed policy (drop long-lived low-priority connections) before global disables, and better per-tenant telemetry.

emily: Thanks team. Handing to @sre_lead for monitoring and follow-up.

sre_lead: I'll watch for 1h then coordinate rollback or a staged re-enable once capacity upgrades land. Filing follow-up ticket in infra backlog. Acknowledged."
